<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/license"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetches the runtime license status via gRPC (falling back to a
placeholder MISSING status if that call fails), enriches it with the
local anchor's install/creation info, adds installed/released file
metadata and any pending migration record, and flags the response with
managed_by "environment" when the license is controlled by an
environment variable.
